name: mouse-cursor-toggle
title: Mouse Cursor Toggle
description: Hide or show the macOS mouse cursor from Raycast.
author: Dhaiwat10

commands.name: toggle-cursor
commands.title: Toggle Mouse Cursor
commands.description: Toggle the visibility of the macOS mouse cursor

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p .build/module-cache-arm64 .build/module-cache-x86_64 && swiftc -module-cache-path .build/module-cache-arm64 -target arm64-apple-macos13.0 -O -framework ApplicationServices -framework CoreGraphics native/CursorHelper.swift -o .build/cursor-helper-arm64 && swiftc -module-cache-path .build/module-cache-x86_64 -target x86_64-apple-macos13.0 -O -framework ApplicationServices -framework CoreGraphics native/CursorHelper.swift -o .build/cursor-helper-x86_64 && lipo -create .build/cursor-helper-arm64 .build/cursor-helper-x86_64 -output assets/cursor-helper
scripts.build: npm run build:native && ray build -e dist -o dist
